title: 19 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Prabodhini Ekadashi 1999 in Dabhan
story:
A festive day that is remembered as the Diksha-day of Lord Swaminarayan, day of appointment of Lord Swaminarayan as Head of the Satsang Fellowship by Ramanand Swami and the day on which HDH Pramukh Swami Maharaj was initiated into Parshad diksha. Also, according to the Puranas it is celebrated as Prabodhini Ekadashi (or Dev Uthi Ekadashi) and Tulsi vivah.

After the morning arti, while Swamishri was circumambulating the mandir, a few novices (sadhaks) and sadhus were each holding a piece of paper. Each paper had different sized zeros drawn on it. As Swamishri came by, he humorously referred to each shape of zeros held by a corresponding sadhak: "I am long, I am fat, I am round, I am uneven." The novices said, "Swami Bapa! We are zeros of different shapes and sizes but you are the numeral 1. Through your association we (the zeros) have attained worth. Swamishri responded: "Yes, that is true, God and His holy sadhu is 1. Through the association of Yogiji Maharaj you have… (attained worth)." Swamishri then blessed the novices and sadhus.

Several active and enthusiastic youths of Sarangpur were introduced to Swamishri. Whenever the need arises, these youths selflessly offer voluntary services in Sarangpur and the neighboring villages. Swamishri was pleased by their spirit of service and advised, "Sarangpur is a pilgrim place. And there should be purity and piety here. Don't allow gambling, liquor and meat-eating in the village. Since you are offering your noble services in the village, do bear this in mind."

Visits sacred sites in Dabhan. Visits sacred sites in Dabhan.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs the murti-pratishtha rituals of six BAPS hari mandirs; Sirpur and Sahada (Khandesh region), Khanjroli, Madharkui, Kamalapor and Sathvav
options.story:
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of six BAPS hari mandirs; Sirpur and Sahada (Khandesh region), Khanjroli, Madharkui, Kamalapor and Sathvav.

Performs murti-pratishtha arti. Says Jai Swaminarayan to all. Performs murti-pratishtha rituals for Shirpur and Shahda kamalpor. Performs murti-pratishtha arti for mandirs of Kamalpor and Motherkui. Kamalpor, Motherkui and Sathvav. Khanjroli and Shirpur. Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj adorned with flowers. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Radha-Krishna Dev. Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Murtis for new hari mandir for Shirpur and Shahda.

options.headline: Prabodhini Ekadashi 2018 in Bochasan
options.story:
Performs the morning arti. Engrossed in darshan of Thakorji. Performs abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Performs pradakshina of shrine.

Blesses the assembly. Performs the evening arti in his room. Performs his daily puja. Sanctifies various vegetables offered in Thakorji's 'Haatadi'.

Arrives for his daily puja. Engaged in darshan of the memorial shrine at the place sanctified by Shri Nilkanth Varni in Bochasan village. Engrossed in darshan of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj. Offers thal to Shri Harikrishna Maharaj.

Sanctifies various vegetables offered in Thakorji's 'Haatadi' on Prabodhini Ekadashi. Engrossed in darshan in the room of gurus Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj, Yogiji Maharaj and Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Engrossed in darshan of Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj. Visits the shrine of Purushottamdas Swami (Khandeshi).

Observes a rangoli of vegetables. Engrossed in the darshan of a door sanctified by Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj, BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, Bochasan. Annakut of vegetables (Haatadi) offered to Thakorji on Prabodhini Ekadashi.

Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Lakshmi-Narayan Dev. Brahmaswarup Bhagatji Maharaj. Brahmaswarup Shastriji Maharaj. Brahmaswarup Yogiji Maharaj.

Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Sadhus and bhaktas doing darshan of arti. Sadhus perform abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Watches children perform mukhpath.

Shri Harikrishna Maharaj in Bapa's daily puja.
